reason: I'm not handing a bot my Google account and letting it sit in my work chats reading everything my guys send. Half my spending is cash to mechanics anyway, and I can get through the receipts myself with a free spreadsheet.
objection: Who is behind this bot and what happens to my Google Drive and chat messages once it has access? I can't see anyone accountable.
would_change_my_mind: A setup where it only gets access to one sheet it creates, not my whole Google account, plus a known local company standing behind it that someone I trust already uses.
